scope: Recursive value types, independent copies/captures, stable traversal views and compact box allocation. No new whole-stage performance baseline is accepted.

upstream.description: Recursive value fields use private copy-on-write boxes with iterative destruction. Adapted to Dewy callable copying, narrowed capture writes, JSON writers and C ABI checks. Existing nested-optional semantics are retained. Recursive tree fixture uses explicit half-open ranges to preserve upstream iteration counts. Dewy additionally packs small boxes into allocator header space with size-aware freeing; large allocations retain their full allocator header.

Read-only traversal locals borrow stable parts of value parameters in release builds. Adapted to Dewy parameter views, closure/private-state exclusions, raw-storage exposure and repeated lowering. Fixture variant if/loop-let forms use equivalent match forms; bounded ranges are explicit. Dewy synthetic borrowed parameter bindings remain analysis roots; optional held views use null/biased addresses internally to avoid per-node optional-tag loads. A cached inline-box layout flag enables recursive traversal views in default builds too, while unrelated managed aggregates remain release-only.
